annotations.title: See the replies to ad leads

description: Reads how a WhatsApp number answers a new chat from one of its Click-to-WhatsApp ads: who answers (the product card then the AI receptionist, the AI receptionist from the first message, or the product card then the business), the wait before the first reply, whether it answers only while the business is closed and its opening hours, the greeting (a saved reply), the default product and the one question, each ad the number’s chats came from with its own product and the product Cosend suggests from the ad’s headline, and the follow-up: after how many quiet days, the saved reply and marketing template one tap sends, and the optional nudge. Read-only.

id.description: The WhatsApp number, by its conn_ id.
